item.title: Pundit Identifies “Extremely Great Indicator” to Predict XRP Price Trends
item.description: XRP has been under steady selling pressure, but data suggests its futures Open Interest metric could spot the next big move. item.title: UAE’s Second-Largest Bank Calls Bitcoin Digital Gold, Considers Adding BTC to Its Investment Portfolio
